description: Who made the vehicle with this VIN prefix? Decodes a World Manufacturer Identifier (the first 3 characters of a VIN, or 6 for small makers whose third character is 9) to the manufacturer, make, vehicle type and broad region, and accepts a full 17-character VIN to read its prefix. For fleet, import, parts and used-car checks. Source: NHTSA vPIC. It identifies the maker only, not the specific vehicle; use a full VIN decoder for model and specification. (cost: 1 credit)

wmi.description: string, required, 3- or 6-character WMI (e.g. 1HG) or a full 17-character VIN

name: wmi_manufacturer_lookup
